subject: Boston Events — October 14 – October 31, 2026
intro: Hey Boston! Your October 14–31 edition connects Boston, Cambridge and nearby Newton: practical AI discussions and agent-building, the Head of the Charles Regatta, the Boston Book Festival, neighborhood conversation, waterfront art and Halloween. Check each organizer’s current registration and entry requirements. Brattle Book Shop is our business spotlight, and Boston Cares is our community spotlight. Our AI Ethics readings focus on bias, accessibility, public accountability and how people can instruct and evaluate AI responsibly.

events.title: Parks Fitness: Line Dancing with Angela
events.description: The final Wednesday of the City’s free fall line-dancing series. A Boston Parks and Recreation and Boston Public Health Commission fitness program sponsored by Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts. Check the official listing for instructor and weather updates.
events.source: City of Boston calendar; weekly Wednesday recurrence ends October 14, 2026

events.title: Roslindale Coffee Hour
events.description: Join Mayor Michelle Wu and City staff for free coffee and conversation in Roslindale. Bring questions about your neighborhood and confirm any updates with the City’s event page.
events.source: City of Boston official event page

events.title: Age Strong Medicare Open Enrollment Clinic — Roxbury
events.description: A free Age Strong clinic to review Medicare and prescription-plan coverage. The City lists a 10 AM–3 PM window. Contact Age Strong through the official listing for appointments, eligibility and what to bring; this listing is not medical or insurance advice.
events.source: City of Boston official event page

events.title: ICA Free Thursday Night
events.description: Free museum admission from 5–9 PM. Free tickets are required; last entry is 8:30 PM, and on-site reservations are not guaranteed. Book the matching Thursday through the museum’s official ticket link.
events.source: ICA Boston official October 2026 calendar and event page

events.title: AI Panel: You Already Have an AI Strategy. You Just Didn’t Choose It.
events.description: Charles River Regional Chamber hosts a Boston AI Week panel on workforce adoption, human trust, professional accountability and how customers find businesses. The venue is in Newton, not downtown Boston. Consult the event listing for current attendance details.
events.source: Boston AI Week verified schedule and detailed host listing

events.title: Head of the Charles Regatta
events.date: October 16–18, 2026 — see the official race schedule
events.description: The 2026 regatta takes place October 16–18 along the Charles. The organizer separately sells hospitality tickets. Check the official race schedule and spectator information before choosing a viewing location; this date-only listing does not guess race times.
events.source: Head of the Charles official 2026 homepage

events.title: Boston Book Festival
events.date: Saturday, October 17, 2026 — see the session schedule
events.description: The free public literary festival returns to Copley Square on October 17. Follow the official 2026 schedule for authors, session locations and individual start times. Exhibitor applications are closed; that is separate from attending the public festival.
events.source: Boston Book Festival official 2026 schedule and exhibitor information

events.title: Waterfront Art Walk
events.description: A free guided walk connecting Commonwealth Pier and the ICA’s waterfront public art. Meet at Harbor Plaza on Commonwealth Pier. The walk takes about one hour and does not require advance registration.
events.source: ICA Boston official October 2026 guided-walk schedule

events.title: The Missing Layer: AI Governance as Organizational Architecture
events.description: Bee360’s roundtable asks how organizations assign ownership, budgets and decision rights to AI systems. A Boston AI Week gathering on practical governance, not just policy documents. Check the host listing for current attendance arrangements.
events.source: Boston AI Week detailed Bee360 host listing

events.title: Fall-o-Ween Children’s Festival
events.venueAddress: Corner of Charles and Beacon Streets, Boston, MA 02108
events.description: The City’s free, family-friendly Fall-o-Ween Children’s Festival at Boston Common Frog Pond. The current individual event page lists October 22, 4–8 PM; check that page for weather or scheduling changes.
events.source: City of Boston individual event page; verified over conflicting calendar summary

events.title: ICA Free Thursday Night
events.description: Free museum admission from 5–9 PM. Free tickets are required; last entry is 8:30 PM. Select October 22 on the official ticket page; on-site reservations are not guaranteed.
events.source: ICA Boston official October 2026 calendar and event page

events.title: Waterfront Art Walk
events.description: A free guided waterfront walk through contemporary public art between Commonwealth Pier and the ICA. Meet at Harbor Plaza on Commonwealth Pier. No advance registration is required.
events.source: ICA Boston official October 2026 guided-walk schedule

events.title: Waterfront Art Walk
events.description: A free guided walk through art on Boston’s waterfront. This Sunday tour starts at the ICA, unlike the October 21 and 23 walks. Allow about an hour; no advance registration required.
events.source: ICA Boston official October 2026 guided-walk schedule

events.title: Bloomberg Tech Briefing: Building the Agentic Enterprise
events.description: An executive briefing on infrastructure, cybersecurity, governance and trust as companies deploy agentic AI. The organizer’s registration page offers in-person and virtual attendee options; confirm acceptance and current availability before making plans.
events.source: Boston AI Week detailed listing and official Bloomberg registration page

events.title: ICA Free Thursday Night
events.description: Free museum admission from 5–9 PM. Reserve the required free ticket for October 29; last entry is 8:30 PM and on-site availability is not guaranteed.
events.source: ICA Boston official October 2026 calendar and event page

events.title: Agentic Builders Boston
events.description: Technical talks on agent memory, sandboxes, enterprise scaling and observability, followed by networking. Doors open at 5 PM and talks begin at 5:30 PM. Bring photo ID for lobby check-in. Capacity is 100 and admission is first come, first served, even with registration.
events.source: Boston AI Week detailed Red Hat host listing

events.title: ICA Halloween: It’s Magic!
events.date: Saturday, Oct 31 at 8:00 PM EDT – midnight
events.description: A 21+ Halloween evening with magic, music, dancing and an all-inclusive buffet and open bar. Official prices are $125 for ICA members and $150 for nonmembers. Valid ID required; galleries and store are closed, and bars and doors close at 11:30 PM. Review costume restrictions before attending.
events.source: ICA Boston official October 2026 calendar and individual event page

events.title: Brattle Book Shop
events.date: Business spotlight — browse the shop’s current hours
events.description: A Boston used-and-rare-book shop with two floors of general used books, a rare-book floor and an outdoor sale lot. The shop lists browsing Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–5:30 PM. Explore the official site for current services and hours; this is a business spotlight, not a dated festival event.

events.title: Boston Cares
events.date: Community spotlight — explore current volunteer opportunities
events.description: Boston Cares connects volunteers with Greater Boston schools and nonprofit agencies. Explore its volunteer programs, membership process and current opportunities. Registration and eligibility depend on the project; this spotlight does not invent a volunteer shift or meeting time.
